;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Gaza–Israel clashes (November 2018)]]
**[[Israel]] and [[Hamas]] exchange missile fire with 300 rockets being launched from [[Gaza City|Gaza]] within the span of three hours. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/11/12/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-rocket-fire.html (''The New York Times'')]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] bombs [[Hamas]]-run [[Al-Aqsa TV]]'s headquarters in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence-tv/israel-bombs-hamas-tv-station-in-gaza-after-warning-calls-shots-idUSKCN1NH29Z (Reuters)]
**A rocket fired from [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] strikes an apartment building in [[Ashkelon]], killing a man and injuring two others. The victim was a middle aged Palestinian [[Illegal immigration|illegal immigrant]] from [[Hebron]]. This is the first person killed on Israeli soil due to Palestinian rocket fire since 2014. [https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5399726,00.html (''Ynetnews'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Amnesty International]] strips [[Myanmar]] [[State Counsellor of Myanmar|State Counsellor]] [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] of its highest honor, the Ambassador of Conscience Award, which she received in 2009, because of her inaction regarding the [[Persecution of Muslims in Myanmar|persecution of Myanmar's Rohingya Muslim population]] in [[Rakhine State]] and the [[Internal conflict in Myanmar#Main fronts|military operations]] in [[Kachin State|Kachin]] and [[Shan State]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46179292 (BBC)] [https://www.cnn.com/2018/11/12/asia/suu-kyi-amnesty-award-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Pope Francis]] asks the [[United States Conference of Catholic Bishops|US Conference of Catholic Bishops]], now meeting in [[Baltimore]], to delay voting on proposals to address the [[Catholic Church sex abuse cases in the United States|sexual abuse crisis]] until he leads a global summit in February. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/11/12/us/conference-of-catholic-bishops-vatican/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.axios.com/pope-francis-us-bishops-sex-abuse-proposals-0c9ac11b-9637-4c14-bc14-27955e6c4647.html (Axios)]
*[[Marvel Comics]] editor and [[comic book]] writer [[Stan Lee]] dies at the age of 95. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/11/12/obituaries/stan-lee-dead.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/nov/12/stan-lee-fans-stars-pay-tribute-to-comic (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**The [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] in [[Butte County, California|Butte County]] is now ranked as the deadliest wildfire in [[History of California|Californian history]], with 42 people confirmed dead and 228 people missing. [https://m.huffpost.com/us/entry/us_5bea3cc4e4b044bbb1a7b522 (''HuffPost'')]

;International relations 
*[[Killing of Jamal Khashoggi]], [[Foreign relations of Saudi Arabia]]
** [[Prime Minister of Canada]] [[Justin Trudeau]] confirms that Canadian intelligence officials have listened to the recording provided by Turkey of the killing of [[Jamal Khashoggi]], though he himself had not heard it. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/pm-canadian-intelligence-has-heard-khashoggi-tapes-1.4173095 (CTV News)] 

;Law and crime
*[[Parviz Kazemi]], former Iranian welfare minister, is arrested and transferred to Tehran's [[Evin Prison]] on charge of causing disruption in the country's [[Economy of Iran|economic system]]. [https://www.presstv.com/Detail/2018/11/11/579755/Parviz-Kazemi-Mahmoud-Ahmadinejad-economic-corruption-Evin (PressTV)]
*[[Antisemitism in Canada]], [[History of the Jews in Toronto]]
**[[Toronto Police Service|Toronto police]] investigates a hate crime against four [[Jews|Jewish]] teens. 1 person is arrested and 9 other teenagers are being sought. [https://m.huffingtonpost.ca/2018/11/12/jewish-hate-crime-north-toronto_a_23587752/ (Huffington Post Canada)] [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.4902273 (CBC CA)]
* Three men are convicted at the [[Western Cape Division|Western Cape High Court]] of kidnapping, raping and killing [[Stellenbosch University]] student [[Murder of Hannah Cornelius|Hannah Cornelius]], whose body was found outside [[Stellenbosch]]. They are also convicted of the attempted murder of a friend of Hannah's who was abducted at the same time and left for dead near [[Kraaifontein]]. The three men receive life sentences. [https://www.news24.com/news24/breaking-life-sentences-for-3-found-guilty-of-hannah-cornelius-rape-murder-20181112 (News24)]

;Politics and elections
*[[United States Senate election in Arizona, 2018]]
**A week after the election, which was initially too close to call, [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] candidate [[Kyrsten Sinema]] is elected to the [[United States Senate]], defeating [[Republican Party (United States)|GOP]] candidate [[Martha McSally]]. Sinema is the first woman elected to represent [[Arizona]] in the Senate and first Democrat to win a Senate [[Elections in Arizona|election]] in the state since 1988. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-46190111 (BBC)]
*[[Marshall Islands]] President [[Hilda Heine]] narrowly survives a 16-16 vote of no confidence. 17 votes were needed to remove Heine from office. [http://www.mvariety.com/regional-news/108830-marshalls-heine-survives-no-confidence-vote (''Marianas Variety'')] 

;Science and technology
*The [[Irish Aviation Authority]] launches an investigation after several airliner pilots report extremely fast moving bright lights off the south-west coast of [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46181662 (BBC)] [https://www.irishexaminer.com/breakingnews/ireland/audio-close-encounter-with-ufo-off-irish-coast-leaves-pilots-wondering-884774.html (''Irish Examiner'')]
